title: Shape morph
description: One bold shape that morphs into the next on every beat: circle to square to star, a glyph into a blob. Each morph squashes, turns and lands with a small settle and an outline ripple; the colour shifts through the palette. Items that are not shape names are traced from the display face (a letter, a digit, a short word). Transparent, for a beat-synced accent or a graphic interlude.

shapes.description: The shapes in order. Names: circle, square, triangle, hexagon, star, burst, blob, plus, pill, ring; anything else is set in the display face and traced (e.g. 'A', '24', 'hi').

beat.description: Seconds from one shape to the next (0: spread the shapes over the block's length). Use the music's beat for a synced cut.

morph.description: Seconds each morph takes (at most 80 % of the beat).

style.description: fill: solid shape; outline: a thick stroke only; duo: solid shape with an offset outline echo in the ink colour.

colors.description: Shape colours as #rrggbb, one per shape, cycling (empty: accent, secondary, ink).

spin.description: Turn a quarter on each morph.

size.description: Shape size as a fraction of the safe area's shorter side.
